# Round 1: plate width 120 -> 150, right holes stay 12 from right edge.
import ezdxf
from ezdxf.math import Vec3

SRC = DST = r"C:\Users\HUAWEI\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\D--Projects-AgentCAD\d6ee3478-e055-493d-8b14-3ab652e01571\scratchpad\cc_hardB\H1_r2\part.dxf"
OLD_W, NEW_W = 120.0, 150.0
DX = NEW_W - OLD_W
EPS = 1e-6

doc = ezdxf.readfile(SRC)
msp = doc.modelspace()
db = doc.entitydb

# 1) outline: shift right-side vertices (x near 115/120) by DX, keep bulges
outline = db["91"]
pts = []
for x, y, s, e, b in outline.get_points("xyseb"):
    if x > OLD_W / 2:
        x += DX
    pts.append((x, y, s, e, b))
outline.set_points(pts, format="xyseb")

# 2) right-side holes: x = 108 -> 138
for h in ("93", "95"):
    c = db[h]
    assert abs(c.dxf.center.x - (OLD_W - 12)) < EPS
    c.dxf.center = Vec3(NEW_W - 12, c.dxf.center.y, 0)

# 3) overall width dimension (handle 96, block *D1)
dim = db["96"]
assert abs(dim.dxf.defpoint3.x - OLD_W) < EPS
dim.dxf.defpoint3 = Vec3(NEW_W, dim.dxf.defpoint3.y, 0)
tm = dim.dxf.text_midpoint
dim.dxf.text_midpoint = Vec3(NEW_W / 2, tm.y, tm.z)
blk = doc.blocks[dim.dxf.geometry]
for e in blk:
    t = e.dxftype()
    if t == "LINE":
        s, en = e.dxf.start, e.dxf.end
        if abs(s.y - en.y) < EPS:  # dimension line: extend right end
            if en.x > s.x:
                e.dxf.end = en + (DX, 0, 0)
            else:
                e.dxf.start = s + (DX, 0, 0)
        elif s.x > OLD_W / 2:      # right extension line
            e.translate(DX, 0, 0)
    elif t in ("INSERT", "POINT"):
        loc = e.dxf.insert if t == "INSERT" else e.dxf.location
        if loc.x > OLD_W / 2:
            e.translate(DX, 0, 0)
    elif t == "MTEXT":
        assert e.text == "120"
        e.text = "150"
        e.translate(DX / 2, 0, 0)

# 4) hole diameter callout (handle D2, block *D5) is attached to the top-right
#    hole -> move it together with the hole
ddim = db["D2"]
for attr in ("defpoint", "defpoint4", "text_midpoint"):
    if ddim.dxf.hasattr(attr):
        ddim.dxf.set(attr, ddim.dxf.get(attr) + (DX, 0, 0))
for e in doc.blocks[ddim.dxf.geometry]:
    e.translate(DX, 0, 0)

doc.saveas(DST)
print("saved")

# Round 2: mounting hole diameter 10 -> 12 (centers unchanged), update 4X diameter callout.
import os
import shutil
import ezdxf
from ezdxf.math import Vec3

D = r"C:\Users\HUAWEI\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\D--Projects-AgentCAD\d6ee3478-e055-493d-8b14-3ab652e01571\scratchpad\cc_hardB\H1_r2"
SRC = DST = os.path.join(D, "part.dxf")
BACKUP = os.path.join(D, "part_r1_backup.dxf")
OLD_R, NEW_R = 5.0, 6.0
EPS = 1e-6

if not os.path.exists(BACKUP):
    shutil.copyfile(SRC, BACKUP)

doc = ezdxf.readfile(SRC)
db = doc.entitydb

# 1) the four holes: radius 5 -> 6
for h in ("92", "93", "94", "95"):
    c = db[h]
    assert abs(c.dxf.radius - OLD_R) < EPS
    c.dxf.radius = NEW_R

# 2) diameter dimension (handle D2, block *D5) on the top-right hole (138, 68).
#    defpoint / defpoint4 sit on the circle at 45deg; push them outward by
#    (NEW_R - OLD_R) along the diagonal. Text position and leader landing stay.
ddim = db["D2"]
center = Vec3(db["95"].dxf.center)
u = (Vec3(ddim.dxf.defpoint) - center).normalize()  # direction to defpoint (45deg)
dr = u * (NEW_R - OLD_R)
assert abs((Vec3(ddim.dxf.defpoint) - center).magnitude - OLD_R) < EPS
assert abs((Vec3(ddim.dxf.defpoint4) - center).magnitude - OLD_R) < EPS
old_p, old_p4 = Vec3(ddim.dxf.defpoint), Vec3(ddim.dxf.defpoint4)
ddim.dxf.defpoint = old_p + dr
ddim.dxf.defpoint4 = old_p4 - dr


def near(a, b):
    return Vec3(a).isclose(Vec3(b), abs_tol=1e-6)


blk = doc.blocks[ddim.dxf.geometry]
for e in blk:
    t = e.dxftype()
    if t == "INSERT":  # arrowheads at the two circle points
        if near(e.dxf.insert, old_p):
            e.dxf.insert = old_p + dr
        elif near(e.dxf.insert, old_p4):
            e.dxf.insert = old_p4 - dr
    elif t == "POINT" and near(e.dxf.location, old_p4):
        e.dxf.location = old_p4 - dr
    elif t == "LINE":
        if e.dxf.handle == "DA":  # dimension line between the arrows
            e.dxf.start = Vec3(e.dxf.start) - dr
            e.dxf.end = Vec3(e.dxf.end) + dr
        elif e.dxf.handle == "DB":  # leader from arrow to landing (landing fixed)
            e.dxf.start = Vec3(e.dxf.start) - dr
    elif t == "MTEXT":
        assert e.text == "4X %%c10", e.text
        e.text = "4X %%c12"

doc.saveas(DST)
print("saved")

SRC = DST = os.path.join(D, "part.dxf")
BACKUP = os.path.join(D, "part_r1_backup.dxf")
OLD_R, NEW_R = 5.0, 6.0
EPS = 1e-6

if not os.path.exists(BACKUP):
    shutil.copyfile(SRC, BACKUP)

doc = ezdxf.readfile(SRC)
db = doc.entitydb

# 1) the four holes: radius 5 -> 6
for h in ("92", "93", "94", "95"):
    c = db[h]
    assert abs(c.dxf.radius - OLD_R) < EPS
    c.dxf.radius = NEW_R

# 2) diameter dimension (handle D2, block *D5) on the top-right hole (138, 68).
#    defpoint / defpoint4 sit on the circle at 45deg; push them outward by
#    (NEW_R - OLD_R) along the diagonal. Text position and leader landing stay.
ddim = db["D2"]
center = Vec3(db["95"].dxf.center)
u = (Vec3(ddim.dxf.defpoint) - center).normalize()  # direction to defpoint (45deg)
dr = u * (NEW_R - OLD_R)
assert abs((Vec3(ddim.dxf.defpoint) - center).magnitude - OLD_R) < EPS
assert abs((Vec3(ddim.dxf.defpoint4) - center).magnitude - OLD_R) < EPS
old_p, old_p4 = Vec3(ddim.dxf.defpoint), Vec3(ddim.dxf.defpoint4)
ddim.dxf.defpoint = old_p + dr
ddim.dxf.defpoint4 = old_p4 - dr


def near(a, b):
    return Vec3(a).isclose(Vec3(b), abs_tol=1e-6)


blk = doc.blocks[ddim.dxf.geometry]
for e in blk:
    t = e.dxftype()
    if t == "INSERT":  # arrowheads at the two circle points
        if near(e.dxf.insert, old_p):
            e.dxf.insert = old_p + dr
        elif near(e.dxf.insert, old_p4):
            e.dxf.insert = old_p4 - dr
    elif t == "POINT" and near(e.dxf.location, old_p4):
        e.dxf.location = old_p4 - dr
    elif t == "LINE":
        if e.dxf.handle == "DA":  # dimension line between the arrows
            e.dxf.start = Vec3(e.dxf.start) - dr
            e.dxf.end = Vec3(e.dxf.end) + dr
        elif e.dxf.handle == "DB":  # leader from arrow to landing (landing fixed)
            e.dxf.start = Vec3(e.dxf.start) - dr
    elif t == "MTEXT":
        assert e.text == "4X %%c10", e.text
        e.text = "4X %%c12"

doc.saveas(DST)
print("saved")

- 第 1 轮遗留的问题仍在：板加宽后，ACME 标识压在板面和右上孔上。孔变大后，重叠得更多。这不在本轮范围内，所以没有动它，建议下一轮处理。
